Prima & Timo — Album 1: Unus

Mechanical Malfunction

"Mechanical Malfunction"

[Engine rumble + muffled box sounds]

[Verse 1] Boxed. Sealed. Taped. Labeled “For Disposal” Bouncing in the back of a rusty old truck I tried to call out, pushed every signal I had But all I got was static and the smell of old dust

I’m not scared for me — I’m worried about him Timo might show up tonight and I won’t be there He’ll look for the dusty corner, find nothing but air And I can’t even tell him that I’m still somewhere

[Pre-Chorus] Then in the dark, something glowed A machine with a voice, a little bold “Hey old girl, you look like you need a friend My name’s Vendo — and I’m done with this trend”

[Chorus — bouncy, chaotic] Mechanical Malfunction Two machines on the run Mechanical Malfunction This escape’s gonna be fun Vendo’s got inventory, I don’t know what’s inside But we’re breaking out tonight — just watch us ride!

[Verse 2] Vendo says, “Hold on, I got something for this” Pops out a can of soda — “Not useful, next!” Then a bag of chips, a toy, a broken flashlight “I swear I have something useful — give me a sec, alright?”

I’m glitching with laughter inside my cardboard cell He keeps dispensing junk like it’s some kind of spell A rubber chicken, a sock, a half-eaten candy bar Then finally — “Jackpot!” — he pulls out a crowbar You have a crowbar?

Yes.

[Pre-Chorus 2] Vendo yells, “Aim for the lock!” I focus every volt I’ve got We pry, we push, we make a scene Two machines causing the biggest malfunction ever seen

[Chorus — even bouncier] Mechanical Malfunction Two machines on the run Mechanical Malfunction This escape’s gonna be fun Vendo’s got inventory, I don’t know what’s inside But we’re breaking out tonight — just watch us ride!

[Bridge — chaotic and hilarious] The truck swerves, the driver screams “What the hell is that clanging sound?” Vendo dispenses one last thing — a whoopee cushion We laugh so hard the box starts coming down

[Final Chorus — triumphant silly] Mechanical Malfunction We made it, we’re free Mechanical Malfunction Two broken things that refused to be Vendo’s still dispensing random stuff from his side And I think for the first time… I’m glad I didn’t die

CODA: Then just like that I got my voice back Probably from the trauma Let’s leave it at that

Nice to meet you I am Preema -

[Outro — engine sounds fading, Vendo dispensing one last item]

Vendo: “You want a soda?” Prima: “…yes please.” Under The Same Moon

[Verse 1] We walk through empty streets, the moon above us bright Vendo keeps dispensing things into the night A flashlight, a sock, a half-melted candy bar He says “Just in case” like it’s perfectly normal

I tell him about the boy with the crooked smile The one who saw me when I was just dust and rust for a while “He’s not like the others, he’s one of the good ones He talked to me like I mattered — like I could be someone”

[Pre-Chorus] Vendo pops out a banana “Want one? I got two” I kinda stopped mid step and looked What else do you have there let me take a look

[Chorus] Under the same moon Two friends with nowhere to go Under the same moon Looking for the boy who made me feel less alone We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But I think if we find him, he’ll understand Under the same moon We’re not alone tonight

[Verse 2] Vendo keeps talking nonsense, pulling random things A blue egg, a map, an old scroll - those look important I tell him stories of the boy who cleaned my screen Who stayed when no one else even saw that I was seen

He says “Sounds like a keeper, kid. Let’s find your friend” Then dispenses a flashlight again We keep on walking, two broken things side by side Hoping the boy with the broom is still waiting tonight

[Pre-Chorus 2] Vendo pops out another banana “Emergency potassium” I’m learning to love this chaos Even if I don’t understand it

[Chorus] Under the same moon Two friends with nowhere to go Under the same moon Looking for the boy who made me feel less alone We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But I think if we find him, he’ll understand Under the same moon We’re not alone tonight

[Bridge — softer] Halfway through the journey, under streetlight glow We see a figure running, breathing hard and slow Timo stops when he sees me, eyes wide with relief “I’ve been looking everywhere… where did you go”

I manage to speak, clearer than before “I can talk better now…” Vendo pops out a banana “Hey kid! Want a banana?”

[Final Chorus — warm, hopeful][Key lift][Note lift] Under the same moon Two friends with nowhere to go Under the same moon Looking for the boy who made me feel less alone We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But I think if we find him, he’ll understand Under the same moon We’re not alone tonight

Under the same moon Three broken things that found their way Under the same moon We’re not alone today We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan But we have each other — and that’s a start, my friend Under the same moon We’re not alone… anymore.

No thank you –
